title: A Space placard opens the Space's page with the check-in featured, and the CyberUnicorn console tags any page
detail: Owner ask 2026-10-22 after the first House of Fates placard: a tap should land on the Space's own page with a featured check-in box, and the console should program a tag for any page that has a QR code. /n/<nodeId> now redirects a Space check-in node (kind checkin, non-private Space) to /spaces/<slug>?checkin=<node>&s=&m= (lib/spaces/checkin-landing.ts); FeaturedCheckin (components/spaces/featured-checkin.tsx, a client island so the ISR public page stays static) shows the claim box on both the member and public Space pages, and a signed-out claim offers Sign in with next back to the page. Console placards mode gains Space check-in / Any page: search Spaces, events, Journeys, practices, Circles, partners, partner offers and curated destinations (lib/devices/tag-targets.ts), or paste a frequencylocal.com link (collapsed through publicUrlFor). A page tag is a managed /q/<7-char slug> code filed under the page's QR folder with source_tag nfc-tag (one per page, reused), so taps show in that page's scan activity as medium nfc; the verify step polls qr_scans. No firmware change: CyberUnicorn OS already writes /q/ links with a 7-character slug. Follow-up: the console's pasted-link check anchors the host (CodeQL missing-anchor alert 359); the server already compared the parsed hostname. 2026-10-22 owner ask (any feature or person): the tag search adds people (directory visibility, Ghost mode and the /network predicate, as universal search) and Channels; it searches as you type, and with nothing typed lists every curated site feature by group to pick from. A pasted link shows as Link. The Placards tab is renamed Tags (its toggle reads Space check-in / Any page or person), and the Badges box suggests members by name or handle as you type (staff only, findConsoleMembers).
